description: This file is a shell script used for testing and validation of documentation and command output consistency in a Git project. It includes functions for processing documentation files, running tests on command outputs, and ensuring documentation accuracy.

methods.name: help_to_synopsis
methods.description: Generates a synopsis file for a given git builtin command by capturing its help output and processing it.

methods.name: builtin_to_adoc
methods.description: Returns the path to the documentation file for a given git builtin command.

methods.name: adoc_to_synopsis
methods.description: Converts a documentation file into a synopsis format for comparison.

methods.name: check_dashed_labels
methods.description: Checks if the documentation contains dashed labels.

methods.name: align_after_nl
methods.description: Normalizes spacing after newlines for alignment purposes.
